Apple has had a busy fall for new products, but leaks indicate next week will bring another launch, with special edition Product(RED) versions of AirPods Max 2, HomePod mini 2, and more coming.

Four or more Product(RED) Apple products likely debuting Tuesday, December 1

Earlier this week Mark Gurman at Bloomberg reported that Apple is preparing to continue its Product(RED) partnership with two special edition products: AirPods Max 2 (now only $419) and HomePod mini 2.

The launch is expected for Tuesday, December 1, which is World AIDS Day.

In follow-up posts, Gurman says there are red versions of the Apple Watch Sport Band and Wrist Strap for AirPods and iPhone coming too. He also said Apple Stores have already begun receiving “lots of inventory.”

So we’re expecting at least four Product(RED) debuts on December 1:

  • AirPods Max 2
  • HomePod mini 2
  • Apple Watch Sport Band
  • Wrist Strap for iPhone and AirPods Pro

That might not be all, though.

AirTag 2 (now only $18) might get a special red-accented version too, per a source who tipped off 9to5Mac’s Chance Miller.

Lending further support to these Product(RED) launches happening, Apple SoHo is hosting a special Today at Apple session featuring SVP Greg Joswiak. It’s become common for Joswiak to visit New York City for Apple launches.

Apple has historically donated over a quarter-billion dollars from Product(RED) sales to the Global Fund to finance AIDS programs. You can read more here.

Are you interested in buying any new Product(RED) products? Let us know in the comments.
